routes.name: Rawn Chip Hei
routes.desc: The leftmost line from the belay anchor. Shares the start with 'Bosch Job'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Bosch Job
routes.desc: The middle line from the belay anchor. Shares the start with 'Rawn Chip Hei', then veers right. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Meddle Detector
routes.desc: The rightmost line from the belay anchor. This is the correct name and spelling, according to Greg Collum. It's not called Mettle Detector, or Faucet Ass. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Too High to Wonder Why
routes.desc: From the belay anchor, follow the fixed rope to the right, until you reach another belay anchor for this route. All titanium bolts.
